title: Response of an RC Circuit to a Sinusoidal Input Voltage
expert_review: An instructive problem demonstrating sinusoidal steady-state analysis and transient decay in first-order circuits.
learning_objectives: Compute the response of an RC circuit to sinusoidal excitation
Separate transient and steady-state components in time responses
Relate steady-state behavior to system frequency response
Interpret amplitude scaling and phase shift in first-order systems
